_note: Authored input for scripts/build-card-bible.ts. Everything else in lib/card-bible.json is merged from Cass's data files; these lines are written to the brand voice (~/cardblueprints-ops/plans/brand-voice-2026-09-13.md): second person, present tense, tendencies not predictions, one concrete thing to watch for in the next few weeks, no em dashes.

watchFor.ace-of-hearts: Watch the minute after you say something first. Notice whether you let the silence sit or fill it with more messages.
watchFor.2-of-hearts: Watch how quickly you know what they want for dinner. Then notice how long it takes to name what you want.
watchFor.3-of-hearts: Watch the first quiet week of anything new. Notice if a flaw suddenly appears around day eight.
watchFor.4-of-hearts: Watch what you do when someone brings you a feeling at dinner. Notice if you offer a fix before you look at them.
watchFor.5-of-hearts: Watch the plans you make right after someone asks you to stay. Notice how far away they are.
watchFor.6-of-hearts: Watch the yes you say while your gut says no. Notice who hears the full story later.
watchFor.7-of-hearts: Watch the conversation where you give an analysis instead of an answer. Notice whether you felt anything or only described it.
watchFor.8-of-hearts: Watch yourself explaining to someone how they should react to what you did. Notice how quickly the explanation came.
watchFor.9-of-hearts: Watch the week your calendar fills with other people's emergencies. Notice there is no time set aside for you.
watchFor.10-of-hearts: Watch the group chat where you check everyone's mood before saying what you want. Notice how often you delete it.
watchFor.jack-of-hearts: Watch how much you imagine about someone you have met twice. Notice whether you have seen them on an ordinary day.
watchFor.queen-of-hearts: Watch the help nobody asked for. Notice what you expect back by the end of the week.
watchFor.king-of-hearts: Watch the room that agrees with you a little too quickly. Notice what went unsaid.
watchFor.ace-of-clubs: Watch how quickly you go from having an idea to defending it.
watchFor.2-of-clubs: Watch the argument where having the last word starts to matter more than being right.
watchFor.3-of-clubs: Watch your list at the end of the week. Notice how many things you started and which ones you actually finished.
watchFor.4-of-clubs: Watch your reaction when someone shows you newer information than the system you rely on.
watchFor.5-of-clubs: Watch for the debate you restart after everyone has already agreed on the plan.
watchFor.6-of-clubs: Watch for the explanation nobody asked for. Notice whether anyone wanted it.
watchFor.7-of-clubs: Watch the project that has been in research for three weeks. Ship a rough version before the research becomes a habit.
watchFor.8-of-clubs: Watch who goes quiet after you make your point. Silence isn't always agreement.
watchFor.9-of-clubs: Watch for the moment you treat someone's opinion as an early version of yours. It may be a different idea entirely.
watchFor.10-of-clubs: Watch which piece of knowledge you keep to yourself so nobody else can answer. Share it.
watchFor.jack-of-clubs: Watch for the idea you announce before you have tried to build it. Notice how good it sounded.
watchFor.queen-of-clubs: Watch the moment you decide someone can't handle what you know. Ask who that decision protects.
watchFor.king-of-clubs: Watch how quickly people agree with you lately. Notice who used to argue and has gone quiet.
watchFor.ace-of-diamonds: Watch the purchase you mention twice in one week. It may be meeting a need you haven't named.
watchFor.2-of-diamonds: Watch the bill you grab so you get to decide how it's split.
watchFor.3-of-diamonds: Watch the night you start a new project while last month's project still has no customers.
watchFor.4-of-diamonds: Watch the purchase that would clearly pay for itself and has been sitting in your cart for months.
watchFor.5-of-diamonds: Watch what you buy on a dull, uneventful day. Notice the reason you give yourself.
watchFor.6-of-diamonds: Watch the favor you do with a quiet condition attached, and the day you bring it up later.
watchFor.7-of-diamonds: Watch the month your finances are fine and you still feel anxious about money.
watchFor.8-of-diamonds: Watch for bringing up money to end an argument with someone close to you.
watchFor.9-of-diamonds: Watch the gift you buy while exhausted. Notice whether resentment shows up a couple of weeks later.
watchFor.10-of-diamonds: Watch the week you celebrate a result and forget to thank the person who carried half of it.
watchFor.jack-of-diamonds: Watch the deadline you announce for something that doesn't exist yet.
watchFor.queen-of-diamonds: Watch when closeness starts to cost something: a loan you mention later, a gift with expectations, a favor with terms.
watchFor.king-of-diamonds: Watch the week someone's work improves your standing and their name never comes up in the meeting.
watchFor.ace-of-spades: Watch the timing of your honesty. Notice whether you saved it for the moment it would hurt most.
watchFor.2-of-spades: Watch the decision you keep leaving open. Notice who ends up making it, and how relieved you feel.
watchFor.3-of-spades: Watch for the moment your bad week becomes proof that someone else is wrong.
watchFor.4-of-spades: Watch how quickly you say no to something new. Notice whether you considered it first.
watchFor.5-of-spades: Watch the peaceful week. Notice the moment you stir something up, and the reason you give yourself.
watchFor.6-of-spades: Watch the friend whose crisis you keep checking on. Notice how you feel when they stop needing you.
watchFor.7-of-spades: Watch the good news this week. Notice how long you spend looking for the catch.
watchFor.8-of-spades: Watch the argument you win this week. Notice how long it takes before anyone brings you bad news again.
watchFor.9-of-spades: Watch for something you end early this month. Check what was still unfinished.
watchFor.10-of-spades: Watch for the moment someone finally meets your standard. Notice how quickly you raise it.
watchFor.jack-of-spades: Watch for the hard thing you say right as you are leaving.
watchFor.queen-of-spades: Watch the information you keep to yourself during a meeting. Notice what keeping it gets you.
watchFor.king-of-spades: Watch for a week of hard decisions you make alone. Notice that nobody knows what they cost you.

joker.name: The Joker
joker.title: The One Outside the Map
joker.coreIdentity: You were born on December 31, the one birthday outside the 52-card system. Your card is the Joker, which sits outside the deck and can stand in for any card. You read situations quickly and take on whatever role is missing. People see different sides of you, and all of them are real.
joker.sweetSpot: You stay on the outside on purpose. You take the job nobody else picked up, say what people in fixed roles can't, and step back once things run without you.
joker.shadow: Being the exception becomes a permanent excuse. Nothing sticks, and every role you take on stays temporary.
joker.cost: You never settle into one identity, so eventually people stop trying to reach the person underneath all the roles.
joker.watchFor: Watch the week you describe yourself three different ways to three different people. Notice which version you would keep if you could only have one.
